quote: (b)Escrowed Shares. On the Closing Date, 158,740,000 of the shares of New Common Stock shall be issued in the name of the Company in book entry form on the books of the Company's transfer agent and held in escrow (the "Escrow") by the Company for the benefit of Commerce (the "Escrowed Shares"). As soon as practicable following receipt by the Company of a Secure Enclave Disbursement, the Company shall release from Escrow and cause the Company's transfer agent to transfer into the name of Commerce in book entry form on the books of the Company's transfer agent a number of Escrowed Shares equal to the quotient of (x) the amount of such Secure Enclave Disbursement, divided by (y) $20.00. At the close of business on the last date on which the Secure Enclave Disbursements may be received, the Escrow shall immediately and automatically terminate, and 50% of the Escrowed Shares shall be delivered to Commerce and the remaining 50% of the Escrowed Shares shall be immediately and automatically forfeited and cancelled.
